decisions.reason: Confirmed breach: FulcrumSec claiming 86GB theft from Manchester Airports Group, verified by BleepingComputer against traveller records. Real security event with impact on major UK airport operator.
Real security incident: infostealers (Vidar, LummaC2, RedLine) hijacking Claude sessions to drain usage. Anthropic actively notifying affected users and issuing refunds.
Significant threat: malicious extensions with 70K+ users deploying 16 distinct malware modules for crypto theft and data exfiltration via WebSocket C2.
